characters.summary: Nearly Headless Nick is a Hogwarts house ghost. As a spirit, he possesses intangibility and terror-inducing spectral presence, though he cannot physically harm the living.

mechanisms: spectral intangibility (physical attacks pass harmlessly through him)

weaknesses: vulnerable to certain magical artifacts or spirits (such as the Basilisk gaze which only petrified him due to his already dead state)
limitations: cannot physically interact with or harm living people or objects

sources.supports: Ghostly nature, intangibility, petrifaction by the Basilisk

feats.claim: Absorbed the full gaze of the Basilisk, causing him to become doubly petrified since he was already a ghost.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Nick intercepted the gaze meant for Justin Finch-Fletchley, resulting in his petrification.

campaignTags.claim: Nick is a ghost who can float and hover freely in the air.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how a ghost can be affected by other magical creatures like basilisks beyond what is stated in the text.

characters.summary: Neville Longbottom grows from a timid student into a brave resistance fighter and skilled Herbologist. He fights using standard wand combat and magical plants.

techniques: Herbology-based tactical plants (Mimbulus mimbletonia, Venomous Tentacula)

weaknesses: historically lacked self-confidence, though largely overcome by the end of the series
limitations: standard human physical and magical limits

sources.supports: Dueling feats, use of Gryffindor's sword, Herbology expertise

feats.claim: Drew the Sword of Gryffindor from the Sorting Hat and used it to behead Nagini.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Department of Mysteries and the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Beheaded the snake with the Sword of Gryffindor.

conditional.ability: Wielding the Sword of Gryffindor to destroy Horcruxes
conditional.dependsOn: Drawing the sword from the Sorting Hat

campaignTags.claim: Neville is a trained wizard capable of casting numerous spells.
Neville wields the Sword of Gryffindor.

characters.summary: Newt Scamander is an expert magizoologist who utilizes an enchanted case containing various magical creatures and specialized magical tools to outmaneuver opponents.

techniques: summoning magical beasts for combat and utility

weaknesses: prefers pacifism and non-lethal creature management over aggressive dueling
mobility: riding flying magical mounts (such as a Hippogriff)
limitations: relies heavily on his case and creatures for high-end offense

sources.supports: Spellcasting, magizoology tools, magical case usage

feats.claim: Subdued numerous escaped magical beasts across New York and Europe.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

feats.claim: Fought against Gellert Grindelwald's followers using wandwork and creature assistance.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

notableResults.note: Used magical beasts and defensive spells to neutralize threats.

conditional.ability: Unleashing various magical creatures in combat

campaignTags.claim: Newt is a qualified wizard capable of complex spellcasting.
Uses an enchanted expanding briefcase and various magizoological tools.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and Fantastic Beasts series
characters.summary: Nifflers are small, furry, burrowing creatures obsessed with shiny objects. In combat, they are primarily used to pickpocket opponents or distract them by stealing valuables.

techniques: rapid theft of items from opponents' pockets or hands

weaknesses: easily distracted by shiny objects and gold
limitations: lacks offensive magical capability or high combat durability against powerful spells

feats.claim: Stole a ring directly off Gellert Grindelwald's hand during a confrontation.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
notableResults.note: Successfully pickpocketed the blood-pact vial/ring off Grindelwald without being noticed initially.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter and Fantastic Beasts series
characters.summary: Norbert is a Norwegian Ridgeback dragon. As a magical beast, it relies on immense physical strength, tail spikes, and direct fire breath.

mechanisms: thick dragon scales highly resistant to standard spells

weaknesses: vulnerable to concentrated multi-wizard Stunning Spells (as typical for dragons)
limitations: animal intellect makes it prone to wild aggression rather than tactical planning

sources.supports: Norwegian Ridgeback traits, fire breath, scale durability

feats.claim: Exhibited active fire-breathing and sharp venomous fangs as a hatchling.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

campaignTags.claim: Norbert has large wings capable of sustained flight.

unknowns: Exact adult feats of Norbert specifically, though general Norwegian Ridgeback capabilities are documented.

characters.summary: Nymphadora Tonks is an Auror and a Metamorphmagus, allowing her to alter her physical appearance at will. She is a skilled combatant using advanced defensive and offensive magic.
weaknesses: emotional trauma can temporarily impair her Metamorphmagus abilities
limitations: standard human vulnerability to lethal curses

sources.supports: Auror status, Metamorphmagus abilities, dueling record

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Department of Mysteries against Death Eaters.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

feats.claim: Fought in the Battle of the Astronomy Tower and the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince / Deathly Hallows

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: Killed in duel by Bellatrix during the Battle of Hogwarts.

campaignTags.claim: Tonks is a trained Auror and accomplished spellcaster.

characters.summary: An Obscurus is a dark, parasitic magical force created when a young wizard suppresses their magic. It manifests as a violent, destructive, fast-moving mass capable of immense physical and structural damage.

mechanisms: shapeless storm-like body that shrugs off ordinary physical damage and minor spells

weaknesses: tied to the life force of the host child; if the host is separated or killed, the Obscurus dissipates
limitations: lacks subtle reasoning, acting mostly on destructive impulse or host command

sources.supports: Nature of the Obscurus, destructive power, host dependency

feats.claim: Rampaged through New York City, destroying streets and buildings before being neutralized.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
notableResults.note: Overwhelmed and seemingly destroyed by concentrated Auror spellfire.

campaignTags.claim: An Obscurus is a manifestation of raw, volatile dark magic.
Moves rapidly through the air as a dark swirling cloud or mass.

characters.summary: Oliver Wood is a dedicated Quidditch goalkeeper and captain. He fights primarily with athletic reflexes, physical toughness, and leadership in team scenarios.

techniques: blocking projectiles with a Quidditch bat or body

weaknesses: standard human vulnerabilities without special magical combat training outside of sports
limitations: no formal combat magic training beyond standard school curriculum

feats.claim: Played as Keeper and captain for the Gryffindor Quidditch team, winning multiple school matches.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone / Chamber of Secrets / Prisoner of Azkaban

campaignTags.claim: Flies expertly on a racing broomstick.

characters.summary: Garrick Ollivander is a master wandmaker with profound theoretical knowledge of wandlore and magical resonance, though rarely engages in direct combat.
weaknesses: elderly and physically frail under torture or dueling pressure

feats.claim: Demonstrated deep expertise in matching wands to wizards and identifying wand cores instantly.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone / Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Ollivander is an accomplished wizard and master of wandcraft.

characters.summary: Padma Patil is a Ravenclaw witch and Dumbledore's Army member. She fights using standard defensive and offensive school-level magic.

feats.claim: Participated in Dumbledore's Army training sessions and fought in the Battle of Hogwarts.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix / Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Padma is a trained witch capable of casting combat spells.
